years.title: Financial years
years.intro: Years cannot overlap or leave gaps. Documents must fall in an open month. Locking is permanent.
years.addIntro: It must start the day after the latest year ends. The end date defaults to one year later.
years.created: Financial year created with its months and number series.
years.lockMonthIntro: Locking is permanent: nothing can be posted into this month afterwards.
years.lockYearIntro: Locks every month and makes the year unchangeable. This cannot be undone.

tax.title: Tax and HSN
tax.composition: Composition dealer (bill of supply, not tax invoice)
tax.addRate: Add or change a tax rate
tax.rateIntro: Existing rates are kept. The new rate applies to documents dated on or after its effective date.
tax.name: Name

v.code: Code must be 2 to 20 letters, digits or underscore.
v.name: Name must be 2 to 80 letters.
v.rate: Rate must be 0 to 100 with up to 2 places, and 0 unless the kind is GST.
v.date: Enter a real date as YYYY-MM-DD.
v.reason: A reason must be 3 to 500 letters.

num.title: Document numbering
num.intro: Numbers are gapless and unique per branch and year. GST invoice numbers are at most 16 characters. Once a number is issued, its prefix and counter are frozen.
num.empty: No series for this branch and year.
num.frozen: {{n}} numbers already issued, so this series is frozen.

v.prefix: Prefix must be 1 to 14 letters, digits, / or -.
v.padding: Digits must be a whole number from 1 to 10.
v.next: Next number must be a whole number from 1 to 2000000000.
v.length: For GST invoices prefix plus digits can be 16 characters at most.

print.title: Print templates
print.intro: Choose paper size and which fields print. The HSN column and licence numbers cannot be hidden on a tax invoice. The preview is on the web app.

v.terms: Terms can be 2000 letters at most.
v.footer: Footer can be 500 letters at most.

branch.title: Branches
branch.head: head office
branch.name: Name
branch.deactivateIntro: The branch disappears from the branch switcher. Stock and documents are kept.

v.code: Code must be 2 to 10 letters or digits.
v.name: Name must be 2 to 120 letters.
v.address: Address can be 500 letters at most.
v.gstin: This is not a valid 15-character GSTIN.
v.gstinState: The first 2 digits of the GSTIN must match the state code.
v.phone: Phone must be 6 to 20 digits or + ( ) -.
v.date: Enter a real date as YYYY-MM-DD.

wh.title: Warehouses and bins
wh.intro: Stock is always held in a warehouse. Quarantine, damaged, in-transit and vendor-return warehouses are never sellable. Each branch keeps at least one active sellable warehouse.
wh.name: Name
wh.deactivateIntro: A warehouse that holds stock cannot be deactivated.

v.code: Code must be 2 to 20 letters, digits or -.
v.name: Name must be 2 to 120 letters.
v.binText: Rack and shelf can be 40 letters at most.
